summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, announcing leadership changes and its selection of New York City as the location for its future headquarters as part of a planned redomicile to the United States. Will Fuller will be appointed President and COO effective January 1, 2027, reporting to CEO Lard Friese, who will relocate to the US in early 2027. No financial terms, premium, or deal structure are disclosed. The announcement is a routine management succession and corporate relocation. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. Watch for further details on the redomicile timeline and regulatory approvals.
